Theorem
[Surgery presentation of oriented three-manifolds] \group thurston-ch01-topology Source: thurston:page-0010

Every oriented three-manifold is obtainable by Dehn surgery on a link in $S^3$.
Proof

\sketch Represent the oriented three-manifold by surgery on a framed link in $S^3$, equivalently by removing tubular neighborhoods and regluing solid tori with the prescribed primitive slopes.

□
